news_analysis.headline_hook: Oru click-la ₹5 Lakhs varai loss? APK Scam math-ah paarunga!
news_analysis.breaking_event_summary: Kerala Police issued a formal warning regarding cybercriminals using malicious APK files disguised as hospital appointment booking apps to compromise retail user devices via Google Search results.
news_analysis.retail_illusion: Retail investors assume this is just a 'tech issue' for the elderly or non-tech savvy, ignoring that these breaches are the primary vector for draining linked UPI and banking apps.
news_analysis.institutional_reality: Institutions view this as a systemic failure in 'Zero Trust' architecture; the real threat isn't the fake app, but the 'overlay attack' that captures banking credentials, bypassing 2FA by intercepting SMS permissions.
news_analysis.actionable_retail_rule: Never install APKs from search engine results; only use official app stores and verify the developer name against the hospital's official website domain.
